Implemented the first card entry symbol: tasks.g1_tasks.move_cylinder_g1_29dof_dex1_wholebody.move_cylinder_g1_29dof_dex1_hw_env_cfg:MoveCylinderG129Dex1WholebodyEnvCfg as a GymnasiumDriver for the registered id Isaac-Move-Cylinder-G129-Dex1-Wholebody. The second entry symbol, PickPlaceG129DEX1BaseFixEnvCfg (tasks/g1_tasks/pick_place_cylinder_g1_29dof_dex1/pickplace_cylinder_g1_29dof_dex1_joint_env_cfg.py:118), and the other task ids in the card hints are different task configurations and are not covered; they are named in facts.md. NOT COVERED: the full joint-position action vector (the fake uses two reduced joint targets; the deployed action covers every articulation joint and its count and limits live in the USD asset named at robots/unitree.py:538, not in the clone text, so no bound is invented and the action space is unbounded). NOT COVERED: the 480x640 RGB camera images (the fake returns a 1x2x2x3 stand-in; the real 1x480x640x3 placeholder is cited at tasks/common_observations/camera_state.py:81). The fake is a pure Python kinematic stand-in, so the fidelity level is F0 and the gaps state that no PhysX, contacts, actuators or USD model are run. The sim backend (gymnasium.make of the real Isaac Lab task) was not run: it needs Isaac Sim 4.5/5.x, Isaac Lab, a GPU and fetched assets (README.md:127). No hardware was attached or run. Warnings are the expected bridge-owned ones: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed is consumed by the next reset, not a native call); G7.MAYBE_ABSENT x5 for action_space, observation_space, reset, step and close, which come from the Gymnasium environment interface or the external ManagerBasedRLEnvCfg base, not from the confirmed config class; G8.NO_UNIT x4 for the bridge-derived integer or simulator-unit inputs ticks, action.values and seed (twice); G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE because the bridge derives no action limit and the clone states no joint-position bound, so the suite had nothing to probe and awarded CL2. There are no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. This package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null); the gate ran on the fake backend only.
